shortDescription: Destination Email operations on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: email_address
options.description: Email address to receive notifications. Mutually exclusive with I(email_id).

options.name: email_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the destination email address. Mutually exclusive with I(email_address).

options.name: new_address
options.description: New email address to receive notifications.

options.name: notify
options.description: Whether to send different types of notifications. It contains below optional candidate variables.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: send_test_email
options.description: Whether to send the test email to the destination email address.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the destination email address after the task is performed. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For all Create, Modify, Test or Get details operations it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
